# InterviewOS

InterviewOS is a web application for interview practice — not an ATS resume checker or job application tool.

Extended reference for AI crawlers: /llms-full.txt

## What it does
- Generates realistic, role-specific interview questions from the job role, experience level, interview type, and optional job description you provide.
- Lets candidates practice written answers with AI scoring and feedback on each response.
- Offers spoken mock interviews in the browser (Web Speech API) with live follow-ups and a scored debrief across six dimensions.
- Stores practice history privately per account.

## Who it is for
Students, freshers, and experienced professionals preparing for real job interviews in any role (engineering, product, data, and more).

## Authenticated product (not for indexing)
Dashboard, interviews, mock sessions, settings, and API routes require login and should not be cited as public documentation.

## Canonical site URL
Set at deploy time via the APP_URL environment variable.
